items.name: Hannover Mental Breakdown 2026
items.information: Herzlich Willkommen zur ersten Mental Breakdown Competition in Hannover. Wir freuen uns auf einen Tag voller geistiger Höchstleitungen mit euch. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Dieser Wettbewerb ist auf das Blindlösen von Zauberwürfeln und die Disziplin FMC (Lösen in möglichst wenig Zügen) fokussiert. Das "normale" Lösen mit offenen Augen wird bei diesem Wettkampf nicht angeboten. Bitte melde dich nur an, wenn du am Blindlösen und/oder in FMC teilnehmen möchtest. Ansonsten bist du natürlich gerne als Zuschauer willkommen. Welcome to the first Mental Breakdown Competition in Hanover. We look forward to a day full of mental feats with you. **Note for newcomers:** This competition focuses on blind solving of Rubik's cubes and the discipline FMC (solving in as few moves as possible). “Normal” solving with eyes open is not offered in this competition. Please only register if you want to participate in blind solving and/or FMC. Otherwise, you are of course welcome to attend as a spectator. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--24c971553ea864bd55df39455e153dcf0c619e1f/Mental.jpg)

Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCaoCubo2026/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! items.information: North Carolina and Southeast Cubing, Inc. would like to welcome everyone to Raleigh for **[Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026)**! This Pride competition is to celebrate and support LGBTQ+ cubers and allies. Any person may register for this competition. **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71720-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. $5 from every registration will be donated to **[The Trevor Project](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/)**. Their mission is to end suicide among LGBTQ+ young people and provide them support. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71728-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY0MjIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4afae468e469b318f8b2a50ffa9d66355979028d/Copy_of_SOUTHEAST_but_as_a_prideflag_WITH_white_BG.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc3NjQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--347c0316155c3d0a9c0eebd9dc1ad1e753d13e12/PrideCube.png)
